args: sam --help
exit: 0
--- stdout
Convert SAM-format alignments to fasta format, and extract variants from SAM-format alignments

Usage:
  gofasta sam [flags]
  gofasta sam [command]

Available Commands:
  toMultiAlign Convert pairwise alignments in SAM format to a single alignment in fasta format
  toPairAlign  Convert pairwise alignments in SAM format to fasta format
  variants     Annotate mutations relative to a reference from alignments in SAM format

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for sam

Use "gofasta sam [command] --help" for more information about a command.
--- stderr
